title: Topology, Fineness and Separation Axioms for h-Open Sets in Relator Spaces
content: Let \((X,\mathcal{R})\) be a relator space and let \(\tau_{\mathcal{R}}\) denote the family of relator-open subsets of \(X\).  We investigate the family \(hO(X,\mathcal{R})\) of \(h\)-open subsets defined by the condition \[ A \subseteq \operatorname{int}_{\mathcal{R}}(A \cup V) \] for every nonempty proper relator-open set \(V\).  The purpose of this paper is to formulate structural conditions on \(\mathcal{R}\) under which \(hO(X,\mathcal{R})\) is a topology, to characterize the equality \[ hO(X,\mathcal{R}) = \tau_{\mathcal{R}}, \] and to study when the \(h\)-open family is strictly finer than the relator topology.  We establish several sufficient conditions in terms of the relator interior operator and its interaction with finite intersections.  We also introduce \(h\)-separation axioms \(h\)-\(T_0\), \(h\)-\(T_1\), \(h\)-\(T_2\), \(h\)-\(R_0\), and \(h\)-\(R_1\) directly for relator spaces.  The associated topology \((X, hO(X,\mathcal{R}))\) provides a natural framework for these axioms.  The results connect the theory of relators with the classical theory of generalized topologies and with the recent development of \(h\)-open sets.
